functions.divergence: The circular point generation, screen projection, selection sort, reference queries, and both unrolled rank-write paths are instruction-for-instruction aligned after the entry block. GC/1.3 schedules the entry conversion-constant loads, argument moves, projected-array address, and mutable circle-constant load in a different order; it also emits the two integer-conversion biases as TU-local symbols @67 and @69 instead of retail lbl_80651070 and lbl_80651080.
